title: GenerationLog
description: Output-package file recording a generation attempt: config provenance, the rules that ran, the clause insertions performed, and the run timestamp. Emitted on build whenever rendering was attempted. Correlated to validation-report.json by executionId. Reproducible under a fixed clock (no wall-clock durations).

executionId.description: Echoes sourceWorkflowContext.executionId from the AGR; correlates to validation-report.json.

configVersions.description: Exact config versions loaded for this run, for audit reproducibility.

rulesApplied.description: Distinct checkIds evaluated during the run. Full per-check detail lives in validation-report.json.

clauseInsertions.description: Per-clause insertion audit from the renderer. Empty when the rendered document had no clauseInsertion blocks.

expectedSha.description: Canonical SHA-256 of the clause text from clause-library.json.

actualSha.description: SHA-256 of the text actually inserted.
